reviews.review:
ngl when I first play MFP 1, I thought it would be just a gooner game. but I was so wrong. I got invested and buy the triology. playing the last 2 game, got so immersed wishing I could play this game again like the first time. the story although mostly being shown through dialog but I can imagine and "see" what they are talking about. the amout of bonds and hard time they went through together. I wish the ending doesn't end so erupt like that, it make me feel like "that's it?". juno and the player went through nightmares and focus on the mission for the past 2 years. have little to no time to rest. I wish they could have had some little end credit scene where juno and the protagonist have a happy life after.

this make me having post-game depression man. I'm really sad the series end here. 10/10 game
